gloss: one dish, one item; fine article

definitions.gloss: one dish, one item, a single dish
definitions.explanation: A single item or dish, often referring to side dishes or additional items.
An item of exceptional quality or craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {一品|いっぴん}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{一品|いっぴん}⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。

notes:
{一品|いっぴん} has two distinct meanings.

SENSE 1 - ONE DISH/ITEM:
- {一品|いっぴん}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: side dish, single dish
- {一品|いっぴん}⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧: add one dish
- あと{一品|いっぴん}: one more dish

SENSE 2 - FINE ARTICLE:
Often written as ⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧ for this meaning.
- ⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧: masterpiece, excellent item
- ⟦ご{当地|とうち}→ご当地：08936_gotouchi⟧⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧: local specialty
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧: hidden gem

WRITING:
Sense 2 is often written ⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧ (with {逸|いつ} meaning 'excel') rather than {一品|いっぴん}.
